title: User receives HTTP 500 after login
symptom: After entering valid credentials, the user is redirected to the portal landing page and receives HTTP 500 Internal Server Error.
user_impact: One user cannot access the portal after login. Business impact is limited until more affected users are confirmed.
recent_changes: Sample deployment completed earlier the same morning.
Sample identity provider certificate rotation planned this week.

evidence.detail: User reports valid credentials are accepted, then the portal returns a generic HTTP 500 page.
HTTP 500 observed on /auth/callback after successful credential submission.
Sample log references correlation ID sample-corr-20260707-091500-abc123 and exception while loading user profile after login.

operator_notes: Do not confirm root cause yet. Need application logs, dependency health, and affected-user scope.
